summary: Add scope selection to API token creation flow
out_of_scope: Backend API changes, permission catalogue modifications, token editing after creation, scope selection for tokens created through other means, human-readable permission labels, wildcard permission selection

criteria.text: Given the create-token form, When it is opened, Then the available permission codes are listed in a searchable multi-select dropdown, none is selected, and the form explains that selecting none inherits the creator's permissions unchanged
Given some permissions selected, When the token is created, Then the request sends exactly those codes as `scopes` and the created token's scopes match the selection

Given no permissions selected, When the token is created, Then the request omits `scopes` rather than sending an empty array, because an empty array and an absent field mean different things to the API

Given a token that has scopes, When the token list is rendered, Then a Scopes column displays: 'Full access' for unscoped tokens, comma-separated codes for 1-2 scopes, 'X scopes' with tooltip for 3+ scopes

stories.title: Add scope selection to create-token form
stories.goal: Enable users to select permission scopes when creating an API token using a searchable multi-select dropdown that reads from the caller's permissions (not the catalogue), and fix the token name maxLength defect from 80 to 100 to match the API DTO
stories.out_of_scope: Token list display changes (handled in S-2), backend API changes, wildcard permissions (excluded by containing ':*'), human-readable labels
stories.risk_notes: The frontend permission catalogue mirror may diverge from the backend catalogue. If this happens, token creation will fail with a validation error. The UI must display this error clearly so users can report the drift.

stories.title: Display scopes on token list
stories.goal: Add a Scopes column to the token list that shows 'Full access' for unscoped tokens, comma-separated codes for 1-2 scopes, or 'X scopes' with a Tooltip from apps/web/src/shared/ui/tooltip.tsx showing ALL scopes for 3+ scopes
stories.out_of_scope: Create form changes (covered in S-1), backend API changes
